title: Europe’s €800bn defence spending splurge – yet it’s a seller’s market if the EU barely borrows together, and buys alone
lede: In defence, the bigger the order, the longer the production line and the lower the cost of each unit. That is a big reason why Europe has long bought American, for price as much as for technology. Europe could match it by buying together and sharing out the work along the value chain.

title: MEPs resist 17% cut to EU foreign aid, instead seek €25bn top‑up
lede: MEPs insist that they won't allow EU governments to dictate the terms of the bloc's next seven-year budget, and have called for an extra €25bn in spending on the EU's foreign policy agenda.
